Top Peppol E-Invoicing Software Features Every UAE CFO Must Look For
Choosing e-invoicing software is no longer simply a question of replacing paper or PDF invoices with a digital alternative. For a UAE CFO, the more important question is: Can the software create structured invoices, connect with the right network, integrate with existing finance systems, maintain proper controls, and support the business as requirements evolve?

UAE E-invoicing 10 min read
Your Current PDF Invoices Will Be Illegal in the UAE by 2027 (And How to Fix It)
The UAE is moving from conventional invoice documents toward a structured electronic invoicing system. Under the UAE framework, a PDF, Word document, image, scanned invoice or invoice sent by email is not considered an e-Invoice. A genuine e-Invoice contains structured invoice data that is exchanged electronically and reported through the required system.

How Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Supports UAE VAT Compliance
A growing UAE business can quickly find itself dealing with more VAT-related data than its finance team can comfortably manage manually. Hundreds or thousands of sales and purchase transactions, different tax treatments, multiple entities, credit notes, invoices, and reconciliation activities can turn routine tax work into a time-consuming process.

Microsoft's Saudi Arabia East Datacenter Goes Live in November 2026: What It Means for Your D365 Roadmap
Microsoft has confirmed that its Saudi Arabia East Azure region will become available to customers in November 2026. For organisations across the GCC running or planning Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments, this is not a routine infrastructure update. It is a shift in where enterprise workloads can legally, securely, and efficiently live, and it changes the calculus for any business still weighing cloud migration or platform modernisation.
